normalization: Pauli matrices, not tau/2, in O3. Delta C9=-Delta C10=s+t and Delta CL=s-t in common alpha/(4pi) down-quark Hamiltonian, neutrino operator uses (1-gamma5). One calibrated muon lepton doublet, a single b->s flavor pair and its Hermitian conjugate. Three light orthogonal active neutrinos, left currents only, standard mixing and ordinary phase space.

sm_coefficient_ratio.role: deliberately widened matching budget around Y0/X0, not a statistical error or a theorem bounding all running or threshold corrections

CMS.acceptance_role: Integrated yield calibration for the accepted single-exponential endpoints and positive linear mixture. Working bound on same-template response; arbitrary changed background/discriminant or CP phase in mixing needs a new likelihood.

LHCb.role: 2026 combined Run 1-3 result for the real, SM-lifetime branches only. Separate comparison, no multiplication with CMS.

sm_Bs.role: time-integrated SM normalization with independently matched weak, CKM, decay-constant and electromagnetic inputs. The axial NP rescales the amplitude at the retained order; additional nonfactorizing corrections require their own amplitude and matching.

BelleII.role: Combined 362 fb^-1 inclusive and hadronic tags, short-distance signal with SM vector kinematics. Original signal strength marginalized error. Envelope SD width=0.37+0.06, without imposing unknown correlations. No second measurement counted.

EFT_scope: Test complete interference and norm square of a registered low-energy amplitude with only two new constant left-current tensors. Large sign-reflected coefficients are not a model-independent truncation at order 1/Lambda^2. No other nearby thresholds, light mediators or operators at the precision used.
